'''Globe Head''' is a normal {{2|Monsters|Enemy}} found in {{2|Glory}}.

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Globe Head}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Shocking Slap
|Intent = Attack2, Debuff
|Effect = Deals (13;{{Asc2|9|14}}) damage. Applies 2 {{BD2|Frail}}.
|GivesToPlayer = Frail
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Thunder Strike
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (6;{{Asc2|9|7}}) damage 3 times.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Galvanic Burst
|Intent = Attack3, Buff
|Effect = Deals (16;{{Asc2|9|17}}) damage. Gains 2 {{BD2|Strength}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Strength
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Follows a fixed cycle: {{Int2|Globe Head|Shocking Slap}}, {{Int2|Globe Head|Thunder Strike}}, {{Int2|Globe Head|Galvanic Burst}}, then repeats.

== Notes ==
* Damage from {{BD2|Galvanic}} is dealt after all of the played Power's effects have resolved and can be prevented with {{KW2|Block}}.
** {{R2|Permafrost}} will gain {{KW2|Block}} before the damage is dealt, so it will fully prevent the damage (unless at {{Asc2|9}} or above).
* When playing {{C2|Rupture}} or {{C2|Inferno}} with less than 6 {{KW2|Block}}, {{BD2|Galvanic}} will cause the player to lose HP and immediately triggers these effects.
* When playing {{C2|Buffer}} with less than 6 {{KW2|Block}}, {{BD2|Galvanic}} would cause the player to lose HP. This immediately consumes a stack of {{BD2|Buffer}} to prevent that HP loss.

{{Clear}}
